verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships a built-in 'AI Support Assistant' in its dashboard that users can delegate troubleshooting tasks to before opening a support ticket, using docs and known solutions to resolve issues (fivetran-docs-44, fivetran-docs-66). However, this in-product assistant is scoped narrowly to support/troubleshooting rather than general task delegation across the platform (e.g., building connectors, running transformations); broader agentic delegation is instead handled via external MCP/CLI plugins, not the in-product assistant itself. Missing for 10: evidence the built-in assistant can perform actual platform tasks (not just answer support questions), independent user reviews of the assistant's effectiveness.
